paper_title: One-Electron Quantum Cyclotron as a Milli-eV Dark-Photon Detector
notes: Single trapped electron quantum cyclotron used as dark photon dark matter detector at 148 GHz (0.612276 meV). Limit epsilon < 3.2e-11 at 90% CL, ~75x better than previous constraints. The measured limit is a single point in a narrow mass band. A projected sensitivity curve (n_e=10, r=25mm spherical trap) is also shown but is a separate future projection. | Vision: Figure 5(a). Narrow exclusion band centered at m_A'=0.612276 meV (148 GHz). X-axis is m_A' - 0.612276 43 meV with ×10^-6 multiplier; converted to absolute eV (center=6.1228e-4 eV). Lower boundary of red 'this work' curve traced; minimum epsilon = 3.2e-11 per Eq. (8). Band half-width ~0.55e-6 meV. Coupling is kinetic mixing epsilon (chi). | Calibration: No calibration needed
